summary: Six sanitized responses from the owner-dispatched live-trial.yml capture run of 2026-11-12 (pss1 and pss5, read-only): pss5's profile (DeviceLogin17), FindUserRanking for both, ListPvPBattles2 for pss1 (10 battles) and pss5 (none), and pss1's server settings field summary. Each was written by run.py --capture-reads, re-downloaded, re-scanned and read in full; no value was edited by hand. pss1's profile is left out because its creation date and lifetime PvP totals could identify it.  The README rows record date, game version and sanitization steps. The owner reviews and merges this slice.
